system.description:
To the unaccustomed, armor is heavy, hot and uncomfortable. Characters without Armor Training who wear light mail suffer +1 Ob penalty to all tests. Wearing heavy mail or heavier without Armor Training incurs a +2 Ob penalty. Armor Training mitigates these penalties completely. It also mitigates fatigue penalties for wearing all types of armor. Clumsy Weight penalties still apply.

*Training Root is for Aptitude only.

Skill Type: Martial Training. Tools: No.

Root: Power/Speed*

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 256
